source.title: UV Unwrapping in Blender (Full Beginner Tutorial) #b3d
source.creator: CG Boost

analysis.study_scope: Analysis of UV unwrapping techniques from 1800 to 2400 seconds, covering sphere pole straightening, complex shape decomposition, button hole unwrapping, and initial organic head primitive analysis.

episodes.problem: Texture pinching and UV distortion at UV sphere poles after UV straightening.
episodes.observed_fact: Pole edges are marked as seams, UV quads straightened, inner grid vertices pinned with P, Live Unwrap triggered by moving UVs, then unpinned and packed.
episodes.instructor_claim: Straightening UVs distorts boundary pole triangles unless quad faces are pinned during Live Unwrap.
episodes.interpretation: Pinning rectilinear quad UVs forces Live Unwrap to recalculate boundary triangles cleanly.
episodes.hypothesis: Constraining quad UVs isolates pole triangles, allowing auto-relaxation without skewing grid faces.
episodes.reference_evidence: Severe checker texture distortion and collapsed UV vertices at sphere poles.
episodes.modeling_decision: Pin stable quad UVs, enable Live Unwrap, translate UV selection to trigger solve, then unpin and pack.
episodes.visible_action: Circle selects pole edges, marks seams, applies Straighten UVs, selects quad UVs, presses P, enables Live Unwrap, drags UVs, presses Alt+P, and packs islands.
episodes.spoken_reason: Fix pinching at poles and straighten boundary UV distortion.
episodes.topology_surface_effect: Pole triangles align neatly into clean UV boundary islands without texture pinching.
episodes.failure: Straightening UVs without pinning quad geometry leaves pole triangles collapsed.
episodes.correction: Pin quad grid UVs before triggering Live Unwrap.
episodes.alternatives: Manually align individual pole UV vertices.
episodes.transferable_principle: Pin stable quad UV geometry during Live Unwrap to allow tricky boundary triangles to resolve distortion-free.

episodes.problem: Unwrapping interconnected multi-primitive object containing a cube, curved cylinder, and sphere end.
episodes.observed_fact: Seams are added at component junction loops to separate cube, cylinder, and sphere into distinct UV islands prior to unwrapping.
episodes.instructor_claim: Separating contiguous merged meshes into primitive components simplifies seam placement and UV straightening.
episodes.interpretation: Isolating distinct primitive shapes at topological junction lines prevents cross-geometry UV distortion.
episodes.hypothesis: Deconstructing compound shapes stops non-uniform stretching from propagating across geometric transitions.
episodes.reference_evidence: Weird Cube model with contiguous cube, bent pipe, and spherical cap geometry.
episodes.modeling_decision: Place seam loops at primitive transition boundaries to unwrap each primitive separately.
episodes.visible_action: Selects junction edge loops, marks seams, isolates islands with L, marks longitudinal cylinder/cube seams, straightens UVs, pins, live-unwraps, unpins, and packs.
episodes.spoken_reason: Break compound geometry into basic shapes so individual primitive unwrapping steps apply.
episodes.topology_surface_effect: Mesh unwraps into flat rectilinear quad strips and clean spherical islands without shearing.
episodes.failure: Unwrapping compound mesh as a single UV island causes severe shearing at junctions.
episodes.correction: Isolate sub-primitives with seam loops before applying straightening tools.
episodes.alternatives: Unwrap merged geometry with continuous organic seams.
episodes.transferable_principle: Deconstruct compound models into primitive components using boundary seam loops before unwrapping.

episodes.problem: Severe UV face stretching caused by interior hole cylinder walls connecting top and bottom button faces.
episodes.observed_fact: Marking outer perimeter seam alone causes face UVs to squeeze through center holes until hole rim edge loops are also seamed.
episodes.instructor_claim: Interior hole geometry pulls front and back surfaces together during unwrap unless separated by seams.
episodes.interpretation: Through-holes act as topological bridges that prevent planar faces from relaxing flat.
episodes.hypothesis: Seaming hole rims isolates interior cylinder walls, letting top and bottom planar faces lay flat.
episodes.reference_evidence: Checker pattern heavily distorted near holes when unwrapping button with perimeter seam only.
episodes.modeling_decision: Mark seams around interior hole edge loops to detach hole walls from main faces.
episodes.visible_action: Selects perimeter edge loop, marks seam, observes UV distortion, selects edge loops for all four holes, marks seams, and re-unwraps.
episodes.spoken_reason: Prevent interior hole faces from squeezing top and bottom surfaces together.
episodes.topology_surface_effect: Button top and bottom faces unwrap as flat circular disks, while hole walls separate into clean cylindrical islands.
episodes.failure: Seaming only the outer perimeter causes UV faces to distort through center holes.
episodes.correction: Mark edge loop seams around all interior hole openings.
episodes.alternatives: Cut radial seams connecting outer perimeter directly to hole rims.
episodes.transferable_principle: Isolate interior pass-through hole openings with loop seams to prevent UV face stretching across topological bridges.

episodes.problem: Planning seam placement on complex organic mesh (Suzanne head).
episodes.observed_fact: Instructor identifies cylindrical snout/mouth region, spherical skull region, and flat face section on Suzanne head model.
episodes.instructor_claim: Organic models can be decomposed into basic geometric primitives to plan seam placement.
episodes.interpretation: Conceptualizing complex organic mesh topology as basic primitive components simplifies seam strategy.
episodes.hypothesis: Isolating cylindrical snout from spherical skull reduces organic surface distortion.
episodes.reference_evidence: Suzanne monkey head model in viewport with checker texture.
episodes.modeling_decision: Plan seam layout by treating the mouth/snout as a distinct cylinder separate from the head.
episodes.visible_action: Rotates viewport around Suzanne head, highlights mouth junction loop, and plans seam placement.
episodes.spoken_reason: Isolate the cylindrical mouth area from the spherical head to simplify unwrapping.
episodes.topology_surface_effect: Prepares organic head topology for clean separation into cylindrical and spherical UV islands.
episodes.transferable_principle: Decompose complex organic models into constituent basic geometric primitives when planning seam placement.
